texts:
Parts Studio is live on three.ws. Paste a link to a 3D model and it splits the mesh into named parts, cutting at disconnected shells and concave creases, so each piece can be isolated, hidden or exported on its own.

The mannequin in the reel came back as 24 parts, found from the geometry alone.

Agents get the same tool: segment_model over MCP, and a plain REST endpoint at /api/forge-segment. The segmentation worker runs on Google Cloud Run.

Paste a link and try it: three.ws/segment
